title: F4: scorecard text tables show calls, waste_pct, blocked and turns for --by task and --by goal (today only --json carries them)
spec:
Phase E E4 (T-0230) made scorecard.by_task() and by_goal() compute calls/waste_pct/blocked from runs/jev/gate.jsonl and turns from run records, but orchestrator/cli.py (about lines 145-158, the `a.by == "task"` and `a.by == "goal"` branches) prints fixed headers task/role/tier/usd/tokens/wall_s and goal/usd/execute%/... so the measurements only appear with --json. Verified 2026-09-19 18:55: --json shows T-0244 calls 9 waste_pct 77.8 turns 11 while the text table hides them.
Change cli.py: append columns calls, waste_pct, blocked, turns to the --by task text table and waste_pct, turns (plus calls if by_goal carries it) to the --by goal table, rendering '-' exactly where the dict holds '-' and the number otherwise; the total row prints the summed calls/blocked and a recomputed waste_pct (waste rows over calls) or '-' when there are no scored rows; keep the default (no --by) output byte-identical and keep --json unchanged.
Tests in tests/test_cli.py: test_scorecard_by_task_text_has_gate_columns (a fake runs/jev/gate.jsonl with two tasks, one scored waste row, assert header and a row's values), test_scorecard_by_goal_text_has_waste_and_turns, test_scorecard_default_output_unchanged (snapshot of the header line). Reuse the existing scorecard test fixtures if tests/test_scorecard.py has a runs-dir builder; do not change scorecard.py.
acceptance: uv run orchestrator scorecard --by task prints a header containing calls, waste_pct, blocked, turns and the T-0244 row shows 9, 77.8, 0, 11
uv run orchestrator scorecard --by goal prints waste_pct and turns for T-0240
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
